videos.script: Lesson 5 was about one interpreter, the database. A web application talks to several. {{several}} The shell runs commands. A directory answers LDAP filters. A template engine turns text into pages. {{three}} Each one has its own special characters, and each one fails the same way. A value written into its language becomes part of the program. {{same}} An exam called knee scan dot pdf becomes two files. A star becomes everybody. A note with two braces becomes a template. {{witnesses}} Nobody attacked anything. These are values a receptionist could type. {{nobody}} And the fix is lesson 5's, three times. Keep the program and the values apart. {{apart}}
